items.title: Merck (MRK) Gains A New Cancer Growth Story As Valuation Debate Heats Up
items.summary: Merck (MRK) is back in focus after announcing that its personalized mRNA cancer vaccine, intismeran autogene, combined with Keytruda, achieved statistically significant gains in keeping high-risk melanoma from recurring or spreading in a Phase 3 trial. See our latest analysis for Merck. Merck’s recent mRNA melanoma result has arrived alongside powerful price momentum, with a 30 day share price return of 18.0% and a year to date share price return of 40.0%.
